remarks: Meticulously maintained single family detached home in South Wilton's Grumman Hill Village. This home offers a FIRST FLOOR PRIMARY BEDROOM, ideal for convenience and privacy. Enjoy hardwood floors throughout, updated kitchen with granite countertops, GE profile stainless steel newer appliances and new HVAC system. All bathrooms have been completely renovated -with quartz counters and gorgeous custom everything! Beautiful built-in custom library on the first floor makes a great home office. 2nd floor bedrooms for your guests or use a bedroom as a 2nd home office or exercise space. Step outside through the glass slider to a delightful patio & private backyard with a quiet view of the perennial gardens & peaceful forest. Custom-built closets, new thermostats, new lighting - many updates! Enormous easy access walk-in attic on 2nd floor is welcome additional space for all your extra belongings. 2 car garage with new garage door/remote. The best commuter location in town so close to the train stations and Route 7 - this is an ideal location! Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy easy living in this wonderful community with City water/sewer.  Monthly common HOA $330 /month.
